异地备份备份集所在地域。
> 
> - 当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填。
description.en:
The region where the geo-redundancy backup set resides.
> 
> - This parameter is required when you query a geo-redundancy backup.

description.zh:
异地备份源实例所在区域。
> 
> - 当查询的是异地备份时，需要且必填。
description.en:
The region where the source instance of the geo-redundancy backup resides.
> 
> - This parameter is required when you query a geo-redundancy backup.

title.zh: 查询分片集群可恢复时间段
title.en: Query restorable time range of a sharded cluster

descriptions.zh:
- MongoDB实例需要为分片集群实例，大版本为4.4及以上版本，存储模式为ESSD云盘版。
- 仅2023年10月19日之前创建的实例需要调用TransferClusterBackup接口切换至集群备份模式。已切换集群备份模式或2023年10月19日及以后新建的MongoDB云盘版分片集群实例可以直接调用该接口。
descriptions.en:
- The MongoDB instance must be a sharded cluster instance that runs major engine version 4.4 or later and uses standard SSDs as the storage pattern.
- Only instances created before October 19, 2023 need to invoke the TransferClusterBackup operation to switch to the cluster backup mode. Instances that have been switched to the cluster backup mode or sharded cluster instances with cloud disks created on or after October 19, 2023 can directly invoke this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-cluster-recover-time --db-instance-id dds-bp18f7d6b6a70000 --src-region cn-beijing --dest-region cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-xxxx --only-db-table-recovery true --region cn-hangzhou
